description: Generates the state space for a feature, form or screen across data, loading, permission, network, account, content, time, concurrency, outside dependencies, money, consistency and people, and lists the gaps most likely to cause real harm. Call it when a feature is described and you want to know what nobody drew.

known_dimensions.description: Optional: dimensions you already cover, so they are skipped.
